figures.label: Graphical abstract (unnumbered)
figures.caption_paraphrase: Conceptual suppression of homogeneous nucleation and promotion of seeded growth, paired with a simulated concentration map.
figures.sample_linkage: Conceptual summary; not an additional experimental sample.

figures.caption_paraphrase: Absorption, TEM and PL compare high-OA and low-OA zb-CdSe/CdS seeded growth.

quantitative_facts.name: TEM sampling time
quantitative_facts.scope: panel b; d-f stated same as a-c

quantitative_facts.name: typical high-OA PLQY
quantitative_facts.qualifier: typical range, not a single labeled batch

figures.sample_linkage: Seed loading is not assigned among25/50/100nmol method alternatives. Phase context in SI S2d; PLQY55% in Table1.
unresolved: Irregular shape prevents a reported shell thickness.

figures.label: Figure3
figures.caption_paraphrase: Absorbance-derived yield curves compare seeded high/low-OA CdS and unseeded CdS; ZnSe with and without seeds.
figures.sample_linkage: These are related time series and controls, not independent points to count as new synthesis batches.

quantitative_facts.name: CdS apparent yield plateau
quantitative_facts.qualifier: Author-derived and potentially underestimated/affected by optical constants

unresolved: Exact point coordinates/error bars not tabulated; no digitization performed.
Yield normalization assumes stoichiometry and uses bulk-derived absorption constants.

figures.label: Figure4
figures.caption_paraphrase: Optical spectra, TEM insets and seeded/unseeded yield curves for wz-CdSe/CdS and wz-CdSe/ZnSe.
figures.sample_linkage: a-c CdS, d-f ZnSe. Caption says d-f same as a-c, including inset conventions, but exact link to Table1 samples remains unassigned.

quantitative_facts.name: TEM inset sampling time
quantitative_facts.scope: caption a; d inherits same-as wording

unresolved: Spectral peak wavelengths remain essentially constant for wz-ZnSe but no exact values reported.

figures.label: Figure5

figures.sample_linkage: No experimental run; c/d seed distribution imposed numerically.
unresolved: No COMSOL files or numeric trajectory arrays supplied; not independently reproduced.

figures.label: Kinetic scheme, equations9-11 (unnumbered scheme)
figures.caption_paraphrase: P converts to M; critical monomer aggregation nucleates nanocrystals; monomer attachment grows existing nanocrystals.
figures.sample_linkage: Conceptual reaction scheme, not a balanced chemical synthesis or measured species inventory.

figures.label: Figure6
figures.caption_paraphrase: Changing assumed monomer solubility shifts simulated growth from secondary nucleation toward growth-only behavior.
figures.sample_linkage: Same model seed distribution; not an experimentally quantified acid-to-solubility calibration.

quantitative_facts.name: experimental acid change discussed
quantitative_facts.qualifier: approximately; not a calibrated model input mapping

unresolved: No experimental monomer solubility measured; authors explicitly caution simulation values lack experimental quantitative meaning.

figures.label: FigureS1

unresolved: OA/Cd basis and control-specific exact solvent balance unresolved.

gaps: No simulation project, solver time tolerances or numeric trajectories provided.
k1 and cross-reference conflicts retained.
No experimental acid-to-solubility calibration or monomer species proof.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Method charges5.6mmol OA/0.25mmol CdO, a charged ratio22.4; results/figure nominally20:1.
evidence_conflicts.handling: Retain listed quantities and reported ratio separately. Do not derive low-OA charge or silently subtract bound ligand.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Method charges5.3mmol OA/0.65mmol ZnO (8.1538), while Figure2 says OA/Zn20:1.
evidence_conflicts.handling: All three seed-loading variants retain method charges; Figure2/Table1 measurements remain context only.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Table1 labels d_shell and defines it as shell thickness. The same8.6±1.5nm is explicitly overall mean diameter in body; wz body describes ~10nm particles, table11.2nm.
evidence_conflicts.handling: zb8.6nm follows explicit overall-diameter body evidence; wz table dimensions kept under source_d_shell_dimension_unresolved, no exact shell-thickness or diameter training label.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Generic zb core is about3nm/537nm; table uses3.1nm. Wz discussion says originally3nm, table3.4/3.6nm for distinct shell systems.
evidence_conflicts.handling: No forced equality or transfer from shell-table seeds into generic wz-core outcome.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Zn oleate formation310C; feed injection explicitly260C. Transition timing not described.
evidence_conflicts.handling: Keep two stages and the missing cooling/recovery transition, do not relabel injection310C.
Keep both original values; simulation not reproduced and neither value becomes an experimental recipe parameter.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Figure5 caption directs parameter settings to SI S1, but parameters are S3/TableS1; SI7 says initial seeds used for main Figures4 and5 although experimental Figure4 precedes simulation Figures5/6.
evidence_conflicts.handling: Explicitly record source cross-reference mismatch. Use actual figure content and named S3 section.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Body says diameter increase relative to ZnSe seeds while method and study identify CdSe seeds.
evidence_conflicts.handling: Retain as source wording conflict; core identity follows named CdSe protocol, not this isolated sentence.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Plotted series differ from generic methods: Figure2 includes60min beyond method40min; Figure4c yield extends900s beyond listed360s wz-CdS schedule; Figure4d/e plotted subset ends30min while method lists60min.
evidence_conflicts.handling: Do not equate plot legends to complete method schedule or invent independently charged runs.
